preset: version 2 stores two selected positions, custom order, three choices, numeric order, Solo and timing
launch: custom first question and ascending source choices applied; server template unchanged
deletion: cancel preserves the preset; explicit confirmation removes it

durablePlan: session resumes exact custom order and choice limit after original preset is deleted and original tab closed

stalePreset: source edit warned; ignore leaves data untouched; duplicate preserves original; update retains available source positions and increments revision

concurrency: one atomic update wins; stale deletion rejected
